propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal but passes in isolation due to leaked logger level on the rebar_reconciler root
the per-item decline WARNING is emitted but the pass-summary INFO is dropped when a prior test sets rebar_reconciler logger to WARNING level and nothing restores it
the existing _rebar_log_propagation_guard in conftest.py only covers the rebar root logger, missing the sibling rebar_reconciler root that the reconciler entrypoint sets
caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger= argument raises only the ROOT logger level, so INFO records from rebar_reconciler are filtered at source before any handler sees them
the fix generalizes the log-level containment guard from a single REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to a SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple covering both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots
the declined count is correct by design when confirm_store is None, as no decline occurs and the removal proceeds, making the suppressed summary truthful
